hand_mesh.note: Mesh hand length is projected along wrist-middle axis; face estimate uses skin-colored frontal vertices, excluding dark hair and headband. It is a mesh estimate, not a clinical anatomical landmark measurement.

limitations: Feet spacing follows the model proportions: 32.33 cm versus mannequin 35.63 cm; no limb lengths or mesh geometry changed.
Head angle is the head-bone orientation delta relative to the mesh reference pose, not a clinical facial landmark.
The face skin estimate excludes the headband; the visible facial height already exceeds the hand length.
